plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for this fiscal year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Date" <= '2023-12-31'

panels.title: Total Amount Raised
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Date" <= '2023-12-31'

panels.title: Donations by Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Date" <= '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Date" <= '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST("Date" AS DATE)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "Date" <= '2023-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: The {{p1}} donations received this year reflect a strong commitment from our supporters. The total amount raised, {{p2}}, underscores the impact of these contributions. Card payments accounted for the largest share of transactions, with {{p3.count}} entries, followed by UPI and Cash. Geographically, Mumbai and Delhi led the way, each contributing {{p4.count}} donations. The monthly trend chart shows a steady increase in giving, peaking in December with {{p5.total_amount}}.
